coaching.headline: We won the first three fights (2.4, 3.3, 9.9) and cashed one — then their 12 won fights cashed 9 times and Drongo finished 24/6.
coaching.team: The first ten minutes were ours: 2-0 at 2.4, 3-1 at 3.3, 4-1 at 9.9 — and we converted one of them. The 12.3 bad trade (2-5 in their half, all five of us across the map with no objective up) handed the tempo back, and from 14 to 25 minutes their fight wins cashed into Fangtooth at 16.4 and a tower row from 14.6 to 25.2. The rule this game teaches: an early fight lead is only real if it becomes towers and Fangtooth inside 90 seconds.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: The 12.3-minute 2-5 bad trade in their half flipped a won early game, and the 15.5 fight (0-4 at their Fangtooth, taken while our jungler was ahead elsewhere and never called over) started the tower cascade.

perPlayer.7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: Murdock's 11 deaths were the game's biggest single leak, and the film shows what each bought: the 14-minute death cost the tower at 14.6, the 15.5 death cost Fangtooth plus a tower, 19.6 cost another tower, 23.8 fed the inner-tower row. The lane itself read even; the deaths came from taking flat fights against a Drongo who out-scaled everyone. Picking fights only off a numbers edge was the answer.
perPlayer.16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: Adele placed 28 wards — the support workload was carried. The 10 deaths were mostly team-wide wipes, and the macro repeatedly shows fights being started while Adele was pinned in a losing lane (14, 22.1, 26.8) — those were the wrong fights for the team to take, not Adele's failures to attend.
perPlayer.a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Countess won the jungle read all game but finished 1/9/5 with no armor against a 3-physical comp — the flagged build gap. The sharpest moment: at 15.5 the macro shows the jungle alive and ahead while the team went 0-4 at their Fangtooth; shoving and rotating there flips the fight. Caught twice by Drongo (16.3, 37.5) — on Countess, the flank entrance needs the team already committed.

threats: Heal-stacking: Phase. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought none.
Dive threat on our backline: Kallari. Assign peel for the carry and ward the flanks.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Gadget Security Gate (root 1s), Countess Feast (suppress 0.75s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
We have sustain (Adele) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Static Trap root → Buckshot → Hot Pursuit AS → Long Arm of the Law global snipe
ourKits.winCondition: trap for the root, then out-range with Shots Fired and finish with the global ult
ourKits.passive: every 5th basic is a long-range bonus shot
ourKits.playWith: frontline/peel to protect his low mobility
ourKits.playAgainst: almost no escape — engage past the trap and he dies

ourKits.combo: Security Gate root → Sticky Mine → Tesla Dome zone ult
ourKits.winCondition: root with the gate and trap a fight inside the Tesla Dome
ourKits.passive: FDA stacks grant scaling magical power
ourKits.playWith: frontline that holds enemies in her Dome
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge the gate; spread vs the Dome — she's immobile, dive her

ourKits.combo: Peekaboo! mark+slow → Knock, Knock! sniper → Back It Up! displacement ult
ourKits.winCondition: land long-range snipes on marked targets and reset on takedowns
ourKits.playWith: engage that holds a target in his sniper line
ourKits.playAgainst: close the gap — he's weak point-blank; dodge the skillshot snipe

ourKits.combo: Shadow Slip in → Eventide → Blade Siphon → Feast suppress ult, Haemorrhage true-damage
ourKits.winCondition: Feast-suppress a squishy and delete them with true-damage burst
ourKits.passive: two-ability hits apply a %max-HP true-damage bleed
ourKits.playWith: a team to clean up after her pick
ourKits.playAgainst: Feast is her whole engage — bait it / peel; she's fragile, punish the recast window
